NADIA BRENNAN-AZIZ
Senior Cloud Infrastructure / Platform Engineer
Manchester, UK | nadia.brennanaziz@example.com | +44 7700 900909 | github.com/nba-sre-example

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Senior platform and site reliability engineer with 10 years of infrastructure experience, including six years operating Kubernetes platforms on AWS. Hands-on experience designing and operating AWS infrastructure, managing Terraform-based infrastructure as code, and building platforms that help product teams deploy and operate services. Technical lead with a record of improving service delivery speed, reliability and infrastructure cost through self-service tooling, observability and clear operational processes.

EXPERIENCE
Senior Platform Engineer | Tallybrook Ltd | Manchester / remote | Apr 2022 - Present
- Tech lead of the five-person platform team; operate an AWS EKS platform spanning eight clusters, approximately 350 services and three regions.
- Designed and built an internal developer platform with Go and Python service templates, Argo CD GitOps and Crossplane self-service for RDS, SQS and S3; adopted by all 14 product teams and reduced time from new service to production from approximately two weeks to under one day.
- Introduced SLOs, burn-rate alerts and an error-budget policy for the 20 most critical services, agreed with product leadership; reduced on-call pages per week by approximately 60%.
- Migrated node provisioning to Karpenter and introduced Spot instances for stateless workloads with interruption handling; reduced EC2 spend by 38%, approximately GBP 410,000 per year.
- Participate in the incident commander rotation and wrote the incident and post-mortem process.

Site Reliability Engineer | Brightwater Games | Leeds | Jan 2019 - Mar 2022
- Operated AWS game backend infrastructure using EC2, ECS and EKS for titles with up to 1.2 million daily active players.
- Managed AWS infrastructure as code in Terraform across approximately 40 modules, using Atlantis for plan and apply on pull requests.
- Replaced a noisy Nagios setup with Prometheus, Grafana, Alertmanager and Loki.
- Ran k6 load tests and launch capacity planning, including tests simulating 300,000 concurrent players; identified and fixed a connection-pool limit before launch.

Linux Systems Engineer | Pennine Hosting | Sheffield | Jul 2016 - Dec 2018
- Managed approximately 600 Linux servers for hosting customers using Puppet configuration management.
- Automated tasks with Bash and Python and provided on-call support for customer incidents.

SELECTED PROJECT
Open-source Kubernetes cleanup controller | 2024
- Built a small Go controller using controller-runtime to delete expired preview namespaces; the project has approximately 120 GitHub stars.

LEADERSHIP AND COMMUNITY
- Mentored three backend engineers transitioning into SRE.
- Speaker at a UK DevOps meetup in 2024: “SLOs that product managers care about”.

EDUCATION
BSc Computer Science | University of the North Moors | 2016

CERTIFICATIONS
Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) | 2021, renewed 2024
AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Professional | 2023

TECHNICAL SKILLS
AWS (EKS, EC2, VPC, IAM, RDS, S3, SQS, Route 53, CloudFront); Kubernetes; Terraform; Atlantis; Helm; Kustomize; Argo CD; Crossplane; Karpenter; Go; Python; Bash; Prometheus; Grafana; Loki; Alertmanager; OpenTelemetry; k6; GitHub Actions; Puppet; Linux; SLOs and error budgets; incident management; Backstage (catalog).

LANGUAGES
English (native); Urdu (conversational)
docs.cover_letter:
Dear Corvale Mobility Hiring Team,

I am applying for the Cloud Infrastructure / DevOps Contractor – Fleet Connectivity engagement. I bring 10 years of infrastructure experience, including six years operating Kubernetes platforms on AWS, and hands-on experience taking infrastructure and platform capabilities from design through production.

As technical lead of Tallybrook’s five-person platform team, I operate an AWS EKS platform across eight clusters, approximately 350 services and three regions. I designed and built an internal developer platform using Terraform, Argo CD and Crossplane, adopted by all 14 product teams; it cut the time to take a new service to production from approximately two weeks to under one day. This work has involved shaping practical platform patterns with product teams and making services easier to deploy and operate.

I have also led reliability and cost improvements: introducing SLOs and burn-rate alerts for critical services reduced weekly on-call pages by approximately 60%, while moving to Karpenter and Spot instances reduced EC2 spend by 38%. At Brightwater Games, I managed AWS infrastructure in Terraform across approximately 40 modules and used k6 load tests and capacity planning to prepare game backends for launches, including tests simulating 300,000 concurrent players. These roles have developed my ability to lead technical work, communicate decisions with stakeholders and keep operational needs in view.

The opportunity to help shape the cloud foundations linking Corvale’s new trains with backend services, from early architecture through production, particularly interests me. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my AWS, Terraform, platform and reliability experience could contribute to the engagement.

Best wishes,
Nadia Brennan-Aziz
